risks.risk: A broad normalization rule can continue assigning scores across semantic variants or owners.
risks.mitigation: Select normalization by board kind, preserve architecture tokens, require compatible organization when supplied, prefer direct official canonical evidence, and add adversarial variant/owner fixtures.

risks.risk: The generated index can validate structurally while belonging to an older catalog snapshot.
risks.mitigation: Load the catalog in standalone validation, require exact generatedAt equality, update both validator call sites, and regenerate the index only after matching changes.

risks.risk: Official-first lifecycle can be implemented with an over-broad official predicate or can retain dates from non-authoritative channels.
risks.mitigation: Use catalog provider metadata, select authoritative channels before aggregation, and derive status/date/source from the same selected status cohort.

risks.risk: Browser persistence can fight explicit URLs, leak between pages, or make empty selection indistinguishable from defaults.
risks.mitigation: Lock URL > page-key > defaults precedence, version and separate keys, use none sentinel, and cover refresh/navigation/empty/reset behavior end to end.

risks.risk: Slicing before sorting or computing maxima from one page would make page order and bar scales inconsistent.
risks.mitigation: Precompute the full filtered row set, sort globally, compute full-filter maxima, then slice; reuse the existing Pagination contract.

risks.risk: Reset or filter submissions can accidentally discard sort, column, currency, or explicit sort=none state.
risks.mitigation: Keep baseQuery as the single URL-state builder, distinguish page reset from column reset, and assert retained parameters on submit/pagination/reset.

risks.risk: Changing shared defaults or removing shared text/styles can unintentionally affect compare or source-card evidence.
risks.mitigation: Change only model registry defaultVisible flags, leave compareColumns defaults intact, and remove only evidence-banner resources after confirming no remaining use.

risks.risk: Implementation or generation commands can overwrite unrelated user/Runtime worktree artifacts.
risks.mitigation: Do not touch next-env.d.ts, .workflow/state.json, sealed review sessions, or Runtime-owned run/session JSON; limit edits to mapped source/tests and the regenerated model index.

assumptions.statement: The nine confirmed tasks are T1-T9 in findings.json and no additional feature is implicit.
assumptions.basis: User target plus sealed review understanding and evidence E1-E11

assumptions.statement: Page-specific persistence means browser persistence across refresh/navigation, not server account synchronization.
assumptions.basis: Confirmed requirement and absence of authentication/profile storage

assumptions.statement: Direct official lifecycle evidence is identified from catalog provider metadata and canonical owner alignment, not display-name heuristics.
assumptions.basis: lib/catalog.ts providerById and existing official-evidence pattern in lib/price-confidence.ts

assumptions.statement: The compare page size is fixed at 50 rows.
assumptions.basis: Confirmed Session boundary: 模型对比五十条分页

pressure_test.finding: Typed leaderboard normalization fixes both misses and misassignments
pressure_test.evidence_demand: Sealed reproductions demonstrate semantic variant collapse, owner fallback, and unmatched effort suffixes; source anchors identify the shared normalizer and candidate picker.
pressure_test.assumption_probe: Simply removing base/instruct/thinking from NOISE_TOKENS is insufficient because effort suffixes still miss and owner fallback remains unsafe.
pressure_test.boundary_tradeoff: Benchmark effort annotations may collapse, but repository and architectural identities must remain exact; this requires a strategy boundary rather than a larger global noise list.
pressure_test.root_cause: The matcher models all upstream model strings as one identity grammar despite board-specific semantics.
